Ā. (च्यवते, च्युत) 
__1 To fall or drop down, slip, sink (fig. also); [[Ś. 2. 8.]] 
__2 To come out of, flow or issue from, drop, trickle or stream forth from; स्वतश्च्युतं वह्निमिबाद्भिरम्बुदः [[

.]] 
__3 To deviate or swerve from, fall off or away from, leave (duty &c.); (with abl.) अस्माद्धर्मान्न च्यबेत [[

]]; 12. 71-72. 
__4 To lose, be deprived of; अच्योष्ट सत्त्वान्नृपतिः [[

]]; 7. 92. 
__5 To vanish, disappear, perish, be at an end; [[

.]] 
__6 To decrease. 
__7 To bring about, make, form, create. 
__8 To cause to go away, cause to forget. -Caus. (च्यावयति-ते) 
__1 To cause to move, excite, agitate. 
__2 (Ā.) To move oneself, be shaken or moved. 
__3 To remove, drive away, expel. 
__4 To deprive, take away; [[

P. (च्यावयति) 
__1 To suffer, bear. 
__2 To laugh.

p. p. [च्यु-क्त च्युत्-क वा] 
__1 Fallen down, slipped, fallen. 
__2 Removed, expelled. 
__3 Strayed, erred, deviated from. 
__4 Deprived. 
__5 Broken, disordered. 
__6 Dropped, oozed out. 
__7 Lost, gone, perished; [[

.]] 
__8 Moved, shaken. 
__9 (also -त्री) Free quarters in connection with temples. 
-Comp. 
-अधिकार a. dismissed from office. 
-आत्मन् a. of a depraved soul, evil-minded; [[

f. [च्यु-भावे क्तिन्] 
__1 Falling down, a fall. 
__2 Deviation from. 
__3 Dropping, oozing. 
__4 Losing, deprivation; धैर्यच्युतिं कुर्याम् [[

.]] 
__5 Vanishing, perishing. 
__6 The vulva. 
__7 The anus. 
__8 Quick motion.

€1P. (च्योतति) 
__1 To drop, flow, ooze, trickle, stream forth; इदं शोणितमभ्यग्रं संप्रहारेऽच्युतत्तयोः [[

.]] 
__2 To drop or fall down, slip; इदं कवचमच्योतति [[

.]] 
__3 To cause to drop or steam forth. 
__4 To wet thoroughly, moisten.

€10P. (च्योसयति) 
__1 To laugh. 
__2 To suffer. 
__3 To leave. 
__4 To hurt, kill. 
__5 To loose.
